rationale: The plan correctly uses DESeq2 Wald (with edgeR-QLF concordance) on raw counts with ~condition, control as reference, matching the unpaired 3v3 single-batch design, and explicitly avoids lowering alpha to compensate for low power while quantifying detectable effect size, p-value histogram, permutation null and leave-one-out stability. QC (PCA, sample correlation, library sizes, size factors) precedes testing with an explicit outlier policy. Filtering (count>=10 in >=3 samples) is minimal and justified; normalization is strictly internal to DESeq2/edgeR (VST only for visualization). BH FDR at stated thresholds with apeglm/ashr shrinkage used for ranking and plotting is well specified, though no fixed alpha=0.05 decision is singled out as primary versus the multi-threshold sensitivity table, slightly diffusing the 'thresholds in the test' criterion. Enrichment is well-justified given the drug/liver context, using fgsea pre-ranked GSEA with named ranking metric, HGNC matching, size window, and named collections, though version pinning of the collections is not stated. Reporting is thorough, naming methods, versions (implied by packages), design, thresholds, gene counts, and design caveats explicitly.
